name: @habit-tracker/mobile
description: Habit Tracker for Android (Expo / React Native). Reads and writes the SAME habit.json as the desktop app through @habit-tracker/core, synced via Syncthing. This workspace also hosts the dual-runtime drift guard: the SAME golden-fixture contract that runs under Node/Vitest must produce identical results under jest-expo (Hermes).

scripts.postinstall: node plugins/patch-expo-gradle-kotlin.js && node plugins/patch-windows-cmake.js && node plugins/patch-expo-fs-leak.js && node plugins/patch-expo-saf-truncate.js && node plugins/patch-expo-reactcommon-include.js && node plugins/embed-icon-font.js
